attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family, TUs compiled with peephole on (lwzu fusion present)

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: The load-with-update idiom `type = *(s32*)(p += CONST);` (u8* p) fuses to lwzu ONLY while p's own type-uniform web carries substantial downstream body uses. If the body's accesses are all moved to a second pointer of a DIFFERENT type initialized from p (`Enemy* e = (Enemy*)p;` - a cast transit), MWCC splits the value into a short-lived temp web plus a persistent copy (add; addi rT,rT,CONST; addi rHOME,rT,0; lwz) - the lwzu is lost and the function grows by 2 instructions. Consequence for de-fakematching 100%-matched functions written in raw-offset style: member-conversion must be PARTIAL - convert regions freely, but keep enough raw u8*-based accesses alive on the lwzu pointer's web (or keep the whole conversion out of the prologue-adjacent web) and gate every step on byte identity. Probes proven dead: deleting the dead u8* local after full conversion (web still splits), and moving the update into the typed pointer (`e = (Enemy*)(p += CONST); type = e->type;` - loses fusion entirely, worse).
